**Void Deck now cleans up after itself.** Uninstalling the plugin used to leave the CtOS startup movie on the
Deck forever, with your own movie stranded in a backup file that nothing would ever put back. Now the plugin
hands the movie back on the way out: your own file returns to the folder SteamOS reads, and if you never had
one, the folder is left empty and the Deck goes back to its own boot video.

**A movie of your own is never touched.** If you drop a startup movie of your own into the folder after
installing Void Deck, the plugin recognises that the file is not its own and leaves it exactly where it is.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.5.1.zip` from the [v1.5.1 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.5.1), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
